data.one_liner: Flutter widget to draw routes between source and destination and track driver location.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Google Maps widget capable of fetching routes using the Google Routes API, drawing custom polylines, and handling real-time driver location updates and marker customizations.
use_when: You need to display a route or polyline between two geographical locations on Google Maps.
You are building a delivery or ride-sharing app that tracks a driver's real-time location.
avoid_when: You are using mapping libraries other than Google Maps, such as Flutter Map.
You do not want to configure Google Cloud API keys and billing.
strengths: Simplifies route drawing and driver tracking compared to using raw google_maps_flutter.
Supports both declarative coordinate updates and imperative controller methods.
Passes through almost all GoogleMap parameters.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of API keys and specific Google Cloud APIs across Android, iOS, and Web.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Google Maps API key, enabling Maps SDK for Android/iOS, Maps JavaScript API, and the Routes API, plus platform-specific manifest/delegate configuration.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want raw control over the official Google Maps widget without built-in routing logic wrappers.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using OpenStreetMap tiles instead of Google Maps.

data.minimal_example:
GoogleMapsWidget(
  apiKey: "PASTE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY_HERE",
  sourceLatLng: LatLng(40.484000837597925, -3.369978368282318),
  destinationLatLng: LatLng(40.48017307700204, -3.3618026599287987),
)
